name: Omarchy Warp
author: Chronara, Super Kevin, James Tervit
description: Pair a trusted LAN or Tailscale computer from the Omarchy bar. Local LAN is trusted; Tailscale SSH is automatic; a one-time password installs this laptop's SSH key.

barWidget.description: Pair a computer on trusted LAN or Tailscale, then open the Warp dashboard.
